title: Uruguay's Dirección General de Casinos reports a cyberattack from abroad; Florida and Carmelo rooms closed as a precaution
date_note: El Observador (26 November) says the DGC paused part of its administrative operations on Saturday 21 November after detecting the attack; it announced it publicly on 26 November.
geo_basis: country as stated by the source; no headquarters city given on the page read
summary: According to El Observador, citing a statement from Uruguay's Dirección General de Casinos (DGC) issued on 26 November, the agency detected a cyberattack from outside the country on Saturday 21 November and paused part of its administrative operations. The Florida and Carmelo rooms were closed as a precaution. The DGC says gaming operations and the agency's revenue were not affected and it is working with specialised bodies to restore services.
plain: Uruguay's state casino agency says a cyberattack from abroad hit its administrative systems. Two rooms, Florida and Carmelo, were closed as a precaution, according to the agency's statement as reported by El Observador.
exec: A state gaming regulator and operator paused administrative operations after an attack; the DGC says gaming and revenue were not affected.

validation.note: Only El Observador was read; El País (Uruguay) reports the same story but its page could not be read by this tool. The DGC's own statement was not read, only El Observador's account of it.
